v6-31.candidate: Joash said to the men who stood against him, “Do you now plead for Baal? Or do you save him? Whoever disputed with him shall die by morning. If he is a god, he himself shall avenge him, for one has demolished his altar.”

v7-13.candidate: Gideon entered, and look, a man was explaining his dream to his neighbour. He said, “Look at the dream I dreamed: behold, a cake of barley bread was rolling through Midian’s camp. It came to Midian’s tent, struck it, and overturned it, and the tent fell.”

v7-19.candidate: Gideon and the hundred men with him entered a section of the camp as the middle watch began. But he thoroughly roused the guards, and they sounded the horn trumpets and dashed the jars in their hands.
